nodes.label: iOS TestFlight Delivery
nodes.rationale: Negotiates the origin manifest before single-use credential delivery or an explicitly enabled create-only migration, and disallows origin fallback.

nodes.label: Mapbox Provider Integration
nodes.rationale: Fixes provider destinations, scopes authorization to the full account and owner vault, and restricts CSP to the service and events origins.

nodes.label: Storage Readiness and Recovery
nodes.rationale: Publishes shared deferred-accounting semantics and records allowlisted storage failure codes without logging response bodies.

nodes.label: Connections Catalog and OAuth
nodes.rationale: Uses owner-private encrypted grants instead of shared tokens, with OAuth configuration scoped to exact origin and environment.

nodes.label: Environment Gateway and Index Readiness
nodes.rationale: Uses bounded discovery, admission, and pool draining; durable index readiness does not block read-only authentication.

nodes.label: Public Social Metadata
nodes.rationale: Restricts anonymous metadata to an explicit allowlist, refuses remote URLs, resets custom data-plane selection, and avoids resolving caller identity.

nodes.label: Dynamic Map Workspaces
nodes.rationale: Supports editable map overlays and reuses canonical ACL-checked, paginated Things reads without an item-count cap or partial success.

nodes.label: Shared-Content Request Transport
nodes.rationale: Streams fatal UTF-8 decoding after authorization and rate limits, while retaining numeric budgets for other control requests.

nodes.label: Reviewed Creation Projections and Execution Admission
nodes.rationale: Keeps restored content held until review and refuses execution admission for held content.

nodes.label: Client Discovery Failure Classification
nodes.rationale: Separates discovery transport errors from manifest parsing and compatibility checks; protected projections are discarded on invalid, incompatible, wrong-origin, or unauthorized discovery.

nodes.label: Account-File Restore Writer Epoch Corrections
nodes.rationale: Fences writes, moves, and drains of held restored content through the root content epoch; trusted transaction options remain internal.

nodes.label: Backup Dispatch Recovery
nodes.rationale: Reserves opaque attempt IDs and preserves session and transaction or lease fences; browser requests cannot supply execution identifiers, store addresses, sessions, or runnable intent.

nodes.label: First-Party Backup Workspace
nodes.rationale: Keeps provider configuration, session references, execution leases, and writable intents out of browser reads.

nodes.label: API Capability Manifests and Semantic Negotiation
nodes.rationale: Derives independent semantic feature versions from canonical registries and requires clients to negotiate compatible capabilities against the selected origin.

nodes.label: Thingtime Things API
nodes.rationale: Reuses canonical ACLs, projections, validation, and exact scope filters for reads and writes.

nodes.label: Actions Run API
nodes.rationale: Keeps execution bounded and typed, including URL-component encoding without introducing HTTP operations.
